## About these materials

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## Citation statement
Please cite these materials as: Sharma, T., & Von Grebmer Zu Wolfsthurn, S. (2026). *Citing made simple: A practical guide for Zotero* [Quarto slides]. [LMU Open Science Center](https://www.osc.lmu.de/). [https://lmu-osc.github.io/teaching-material-for-novices/open-research-tools/zotero](https://lmu-osc.github.io/teaching-material-for-novices/open-research-tools/zotero)
:::

**Welcome!** This workshop is intended to provide learners with the theoretical background and the hands-on experience with **using free citation tools** such as **Zotero** to **organize research materials**, **add and manage references**, and **create formatted bibliographies** across different writing environments. They will also learn **how Zotero integrates** with **Quarto and RStudio** to support reproducible workflows and streamline the process of adding and formatting citations in academic documents.

### Who are these materials for?

- **Educators** in higher education with or without familiarity with open research planning to **teach open research novices**
- **Self-learners** with no or limited familiarity with open research planning to **develop and build** up on their open research skills

### Prerequisites

<div style="font-size: 0.8em;"> 
| Prerequisite   |  Description  | Link/Where to find it   |
|------------|------------|------------|
| R and RStudio installed | Latest versions of both R and RStudio | [Download RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) |
| Zotero and Zotero Connector | Citation tool and extension | [Download Link](https://www.zotero.org/download/) |
</div>

### Learning objectives

At the end of this session, you or your learners will be able to ...

- **Explain** the importance of citing scientific literature and citation tools
- **Familiarize yourself** with different citation formats (CSL)
- **Set up and organize** a personal Zotero library
- **Apply and develop** a referencing workflow in Quarto and RStudio
- **Apply and develop** a referencing workflow in MS Word
